text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, listen to this! To tell you the 
truth, last night—I saw a dragon!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Although all I really did was rewatch my 
treasured collection of festival 
recordings!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Festivals around the world are so 
interesting! They use festival floats, 
parade until morning, and—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I ended up watching it until morning! 
...A-Ahaha~.

It looks like she couldn't get much rest 
due to a lack of sleep...
